home.heroTagline: AI-Driven Goat Nucleus & Circular Energy Ecosystem
home.heroSubtitle: AI Breed Improvement · Goat-First · Biogas · Solar · Silage — Kutirchar, Sirajganj, Bangladesh
home.whatIsDesc1: A proof-based, phased rural smart farm in Kutirchar, Sirajganj — starting with AI-driven goat breed improvement (verified semen only) and a goat nucleus; integrated with grass/silage cultivation, biogas, bio-slurry fertilizer, solar energy, and digital monitoring.
home.whatIsDesc2: Every claim is gated: each phase unlocks only after verified evidence from the previous phase. No permanent construction without soil test, boundary survey, and legal clearance.
home.howItWorksDesc: Six phases from verification to scale.
home.ecosystemDesc: Each output from one system becomes the input for the next — goats, energy, soil, and profit in one loop.
home.climateResilience: Built for 2030: Circular farming reduces climate risk, proves resilience at scale, and creates bankable carbon impact.
home.proofDesc: Built for bank officers, government partners, and serious investors. Every phase is locked behind verified evidence. Open gaps are publicly shown.
home.governanceQuote: Verification-first, phased execution — each phase unlocks only after evidence from the previous phase is confirmed.
home.governanceDesc: No skipping steps. No permanent construction without all verification gates passed.
home.brandDesc: Logo system · Color tokens · Typography · Seal · Export Assets · AI Agent Tokens
home.partnerDesc: We welcome serious partnerships with banks, government agencies, NGOs, vendors, and investors. All documentation available in Proof and Governance.
home.ecoBiogasVal: Manure to energy plus cooking gas

execSummary.body1: Kutirchar EcoFarm is a pilot-scale circular farm designed to prove that evidence-first, phase-gated execution can create bankable rural assets.
execSummary.body2: The model prioritizes goat-first AI-driven breed improvement over commodity cattle, biogas over grid reliance, and verified income over speculative scaling.
execSummary.body3: All verification gates are public. Open gaps are documented. The entire project is built for bank officers, government partners, and serious investors — not for hype.
